name: IKEA HAVSTA Storage Combination with Glass Doors
description: Add timeless Scandinavian elegance and massive storage to your home with this stunning IKEA HAVSTA storage combination! Crafted from solid pine wood with a brushed, matte dark brown/black finish, this high-end unit offers a beautifully handcrafted, rustic look. The upper section features elegant tempered glass display doors with adjustable glass-and-wood shelving to showcase your favorite collectibles, books, or dinnerware dust-free. The lower section provides a deep, spacious double-door wooden cabinet to tuck away household clutter cleanly out of sight. Equipped with premium integrated soft-closing hinges that shut silently every single time. A beautifully heavy, solid furniture investment piece that completely anchors a room layout!
contact_note: This is a two-piece vertical combination (top glass unit stacks onto the lower base unit), making transport much easier! Already pre-assembled beautifully, saving you from a legendary assembly headache. It is heavy solid wood, so please bring a truck or full-size van and a friend to help load it. Ready for local pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned solid pine IKEA HAVSTA storage combination with glass display doors and lower base cabinet in good condition. Dark brown/black brushed finish, soft-close hinges.
name_zh: 宜家 IKEA HAVSTA 实木双层玻璃门展示储物柜/书柜组合
description_zh: 宜家高级实木系列的颜值顶流与收纳担当！这款原装 HAVSTA 系列双层储物柜组合，由坚固的实木松木（Solid Pine）打造，带有质感非凡的拉丝哑光深黑褐色木纹表面。上层为双开透亮防爆玻璃展示门，内置可调节的实木包边玻璃隔板，能够防尘且通透地展示收藏品、书籍或高档餐具；下层为加深封闭式实木双开门基座储物柜，完美隐藏各类生活杂物。全门均配备高配自带缓冲的静音阻尼铰链（Soft-closing）。整体已经完美组装完毕（上下两层独立柜体可拆分搬运），帮您完美省去地狱级别的拼装过程。用料极其厚重扎实，高级感拉满。
